bmbrandenburgertor.name: Brandenburg Gate
bmbrandenburgertor.slogan: Walled off for 28 years, now Berlin's front door.
bmbrandenburgertor.line: Mr. Gorbachev, open this gate! Mr. Gorbachev, tear down this wall!
bmbrandenburgertor.by: Ronald Reagan, speech at the Brandenburg Gate, 12 June 1987

bmfernsehturm.name: Berlin TV Tower
bmfernsehturm.slogan: 368 metres of East Berlin, with a cross in the sunlight.
bmfernsehturm.line: When sun hits its steel dome, a cross gleams on it. Berliners nicknamed that the Pope's Revenge.

boeastsidegallery.name: East Side Gallery
boeastsidegallery.slogan: 1,316 metres of Wall turned into a canvas.
boeastsidegallery.line: Artists from around the world painted this stretch of the Berlin Wall in spring 1990, just after it opened.

bwschlosscharlottenburg.name: Charlottenburg Palace
bwschlosscharlottenburg.slogan: A queen's summer house that grew into Berlin's grandest palace.
bwschlosscharlottenburg.line: Begun in 1695 for Sophie Charlotte, it was renamed in her memory after she died in 1705.

bwgedaechtniskirche.name: Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church
bwgedaechtniskirche.slogan: A bombed spire beside a church of blue glass.
bwgedaechtniskirche.line: Bombed on 22 November 1943, its ruined tower stands beside Eiermann's new church with 21,292 stained glass inlays.
